U4: Document recommendations for deploying XD cluster using Mesos with Marathon Framework.
U5: Evaluate Spring Boot dependency upgrades for side effects.
U6: Option to supply data partitioning strategy to parallelize ingest from RDBMS to HDFS.

For U2:
- Design service discovery mechanism for Docker XD Containers (e.g., using Consul, Etcd, or Spring Cloud).

- Test service discovery in a cluster.

- Write Dockerfiles for each component/configuration.
- Implement automated testing of Docker images.
- Configure deployment to various environments (dev, test, prod).

For U4:
- Research and write documentation for deploying XD cluster on Mesos with Marathon.
- Include best practices, configuration examples.

For U5:
- Evaluate Spring Boot dependency upgrades: identify current version, target version.
- Run test suite to detect side effects.
- Fix any issues.
- Document upgrade steps.

For U6:
- Design data partitioning strategy configuration for RDBMS to HDFS ingest.
- Implement partitioning option in the relevant module (likely Spring Batch or Spring XD job).
- Test with various partitioning strategies.

For U7:
- Design HDFS source module.
- Implement HDFS source module (reading from HDFS).
- Integrate with existing ingest pipeline.
- Test with HDFS.

For U8:
- Design configuration for commit-interval override in servers.yml.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement Docker container linking for external services
activities.activity_description: Design and implement linking/binding attributes and environment variables in Docker configuration (Docker Compose / Kubernetes) to connect XD containers to RabbitMQ, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, MongoDB, etc.

activities.activity_name: Test Docker container linking with external services
activities.activity_description: Perform integration testing of Docker container linking with each external service (RabbitMQ, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, MongoDB) to verify connectivity and configuration.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement service discovery for Docker XD Containers
activities.activity_description: Implement service discovery mechanism using Spring Cloud Consul (or Eureka) so that XD containers in a cluster can find and communicate with each other.

activities.activity_name: Test service discovery in cluster
activities.activity_description: Validate service discovery functionality in a multi-container cluster environment, including registration, health checks, and failover.

activities.activity_name: Set up CI pipeline for Docker image builds
activities.activity_description: Configure Jenkins pipeline (or equivalent) to build Docker images for all XD components, including automated build triggers and artifact storage.

activities.activity_name: Write Dockerfiles for XD components
activities.activity_description: Create optimized Dockerfiles for each XD component/configuration, ensuring minimal image size and proper entrypoints.

activities.activity_name: Implement automated testing of Docker images
activities.activity_description: Add automated tests (smoke, integration) to the CI pipeline to verify Docker images work correctly before deployment.

activities.activity_name: Configure deployment to multiple environments
activities.activity_description: Define deployment configurations (e.g., Helm charts, Docker Compose files) for promoting images through dev, test, and production environments.

activities.activity_name: Write documentation for Mesos/Marathon deployment
activities.activity_description: Research and author comprehensive documentation covering recommendations, best practices, and configuration examples for deploying an XD cluster on Mesos with Marathon.

activities.activity_name: Evaluate Spring Boot dependency upgrades
activities.activity_description: Analyze current Spring Boot version, review release notes for target version, identify potential breaking changes, and plan upgrade strategy.

activities.activity_name: Run test suite and fix issues for Spring Boot upgrade
activities.activity_description: Execute full test suite after upgrading Spring Boot dependencies, diagnose and fix any regressions or compatibility issues.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement data partitioning strategy for RDBMS to HDFS
activities.activity_description: Design configuration options for data partitioning (e.g., column-based, range-based) and implement the strategy in the RDBMS-to-HDFS ingest job using Spring Batch partitioning.

activities.activity_name: Test data partitioning with various strategies
activities.activity_description: Validate partitioning implementation with different strategies and data volumes to ensure correct parallelization and performance.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement HDFS source module
activities.activity_description: Create a new HDFS source module using Spring Hadoop libraries to read data directly from HDFS file system, including configuration for paths, formats, and authentication.

activities.activity_name: Integrate HDFS source module and test
activities.activity_description: Integrate the HDFS source module into the existing ingest pipeline and test with real HDFS clusters, various file formats, and error conditions.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement commit-interval override configuration
activities.activity_description: Add a new property in servers.yml to override the default commit-interval for all out-of-the-box jobs with partition support, and modify job configurations to read this property.

activities.activity_name: Test commit-interval override for OOTB jobs
activities.activity_description: Verify that the commit-interval override works correctly across all relevant OOTB jobs with partition support, using different interval values.

activities.activity_name: Code review and cross-feature integration testing
activities.activity_description: Conduct code reviews for all changes, perform end-to-end integration testing across all new features to ensure they work together without conflicts.

activities.activity_name: Update project documentation (excluding Mesos/Marathon)
activities.activity_description: Update user guides, configuration references, and API documentation to reflect new features (Docker linking, service discovery, HDFS source, partitioning, commit-interval).

activities.activity_name: Project coordination and overhead
activities.activity_description: Time for task planning, progress tracking, communication, and context switching across the multiple user stories.
